claim: Patchline ships a counterfactual what-the-agent-would-have-done shadow mode for safe evaluation. The worker loads a frozen, content-addressed spec and checks every item is scored and references concrete backing evidence; the gate then re-runs the worker, confirms every item is scored and evidenced, and rejects an unsupported item with empty evidence, so the shadow mode claim is reproducible on real Patchline self-data via `make agent-shadow-mode-gate`.
